options.description: Same as for the repins earlier: turn the merge hold off for this one merge, merge with the hooks skipped, then turn it back on. The full suite already passed on this exact branch. Then I bind your 17 answers and land INT-114 through the normal check. Recommended: everything holding it is outside this change and clears only once the fix is in main.
options.label: Override the hold once (Recommended)

options.description: I rerun the affected tests from main's checkout so main records them, ask you the five waiting questions, show you the five proofs, and get the other sessions' untracked records committed or moved out of main. Much slower, and some of it (the questions) is what this very fix is meant to unblock.
options.label: Clear each hold properly first

options.description: The branch stays parked as land/report-fix-2; nothing changes in main and INT-114 stays blocked.
options.label: Wait, don't land yet

payload.question: The fix that lets your answers close questions from any session is ready: the full test suite passed on its branch (about 3,000 tests) and its links were repinned after their tests passed. Main's own merge check still holds it: it can't see the test passes recorded in the fix's worktree, five questions and five proofs are waiting for you, and untracked records left in main by other sessions break its integrity check. How should I land it?
